moments.title: US home and car buying runs on loans; a lot of us work on savings
moments.summary: A participant contrasts the American credit-driven housing and car market with an Indian habit of buying out of savings. The audio is a fragment of a larger table discussion and the sentence is not completed.
moments.evidence: the home buying business and the car business works in the US is not so caught up like and we don't take loans a lot of us work on savings
